full_judgment: 6. That this P.W. stated in cross examination, no case was filed in the police station over the occurrence dated 12.1.87, that violation case was filed oil 9.4.87 and violation was made on 12.1.87. For that occurrence he has not filed any in Bandar P.S. This witness also stated that they went to police station for the occurrence of violation and for that Bandar P.S: Case No. 6(1) / 87 was filed and ejahar was sent and it 'was a written ejahar and he did not mention about the occurrence of 12.1.87 in the said of the Bandar P.S. Case No 6(1) /87 and in the ejahar. Dated 14.1.87 he mentioned about the dispossession by the appellants. This witness further stated that a criminal case was filed against them by the appellants over the occurrence of 13.1.87 and Bandar P.S. Case No. 5(1)187 was started. This witness admitted that he had filed a criminal case in the morning he got information that the appellants had entered into the rickshaw garage and before 12.1.87 the appellants were not in possession of the garage. In the matter of hiring of truck (by party), he stated that he neither knows how to pull a rickshaw nor its repairing work. He used to trade on rice before broker. He does not know the dag number and khatian number of the suit property. He stated that he did not see who constructed this house. The house of Charu Munshi is adjacent west of the suit house (garage) Charu Murishi is bhaira of the respondent. No. 1. There is a rickshaw garage in the house of Charu Munshi. He admitted that he is not man of locality. He used to live in Kalagasia which is 3/4 miles away from the suit property. He admitted that he had good relationship with the sons of Charu Munshi. Matin son of Charu Munshi is his Peer Bhai. He stated that there was criminal case over an incident on 12.1.87. He stated that he did not file any case on account of his being dispossessed from the Rickshaw garage. He denied the suggestions given by the appellants about the incident of 12.1.87, about the agreement and about the rickshaw garage.
